title: A Multi-Domain Study on the Effectiveness of LLMs at Writing Property-Based Tests
title_zh: LLM编写基于性质的测试有效性之多领域研究

paragraphs.en: A property-based test (PBT) checks a property of a program on many generated inputs, but writing one takes a property, a generator of valid inputs, and an oracle. LLM-based PBT writers produce all three, yet they have been evaluated only on Python libraries. We study how two of them, Proptest-AI and Agentic-PBT , generalize to ten programs in five domains: deep learning libraries, databases, system software, compilers, and LLM serving engines. Most of these programs take text in their own language, such as queries, configurations, and programs. Agentic-PBT covers more branches than Proptest-AI on seven of the ten programs with Opus 5 and on all ten with GLM-5.3-Flash. Domain-specific fuzzers cover more of the compilers and of PostgreSQL and less of PyTorch than Agentic-PBT . We filed 180 bug reports, 44 of which duplicate reports that others filed after the models’ knowledge cutoffs; maintainers have confirmed 65 of the others, in all five domains, and fixed 23. We draw lessons for building and evaluating such writers: low observability hurts them, and mature fuzzers paired with LLM-written properties could check that each feature behaves as documented.

paragraphs.en: A property is a predicate over software behavior that must hold for every input in a declared input space ( Dwyer et al., 1999 ; Claessen and Hughes, 2000 ; Hierons et al., 2009 ) . A property-based test (PBT) ( Claessen and Hughes, 2000 ) checks a property on many generated inputs: a generator draws inputs from the input space, and an oracle checks the property on each input and the program’s output. PBT libraries such as QuickCheck ( Claessen and Hughes, 2000 ) and Hypothesis ( MacIver et al., 2019 ) run the test and automatically reduce a failing input into a small counterexample. They do not write the test itself. Writing a PBT takes a property worth checking, a generator that respects the constraints the program places on its inputs, and an oracle that knows what the program must compute.
paragraphs.zh: 属性是一个关于软件行为的谓词，它必须在声明的输入空间中的每个输入上都成立（Dwyer et al., 1999；Claessen and Hughes, 2000；Hierons et al., 2009）。 基于属性的测试（PBT）（Claessen and Hughes, 2000）在许多生成的输入上检查一个属性：生成器从输入空间中抽取输入，预言机在每个输入及程序的输出上检查该属性。 诸如 QuickCheck（Claessen and Hughes, 2000）和 Hypothesis（MacIver et al., 2019）之类的 PBT 库会运行测试，并自动将导致失败的输入缩减为一个小的反例。 它们并不会替你编写测试本身。 编写一个 PBT 需要一个值得检查的属性、一个遵守程序对其输入所施加约束的生成器，以及一个知道程序必须计算什么的预言机。

paragraphs.en: Properties can be mined from a project’s artifacts ( Barr et al., 2015 ) , such as its tests, documentation, and commit history. Techniques for mining properties go back more than two decades ( Lo et al., 2011 ; Robillard et al., 2013 ; Germiniani et al., 2025 ; Ernst et al., 2001 ; Ammons et al., 2002 ; Yang et al., 2006 ; Wasylkowski et al., 2007 ; Lorenzoli et al., 2008 ; Gabel and Su, 2008 ; Le Goues and Weimer, 2009 ; Nguyen et al., 2009 ) , and many tools turn mined properties into tests that find bugs ( Goffi et al., 2016 ; Peleg et al., 2018 ; Tsukamoto et al., 2018 ; Kang and Lo, 2021 ; Blasi et al., 2021 ; Xie et al., 2022 ; Blasi et al., 2022 ; Tiwari et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Glock et al., 2025 ) . For example, Toradocu ( Goffi et al., 2016 ) mines API documentation, MR-Scout ( Xu et al., 2024 ) existing tests, and DeepREL ( Deng et al., 2022 ) the signatures of deep learning APIs. Each of these tools is built for one source , the kind of artifact it mines, and one domain , a class of programs such as deep learning libraries. Moving it to a new source or domain means rebuilding its mining logic and generator.

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) can read any kind of software artifact, which would replace the per-source mining logic, and they can write the generator and the oracle that a new program needs. We call a tool that uses an LLM to write PBTs an LLM-based PBT writer . Two general-purpose ones have been proposed. Proptest-AI ( Vikram et al., 2023 ) prompts an LLM with the documentation of one Python API method. Agentic-PBT ( Maaz et al., 2025 ) prompts a coding agent, an LLM that can run commands and edit files, to read a Python module’s code, write PBTs, run them, revise a test whose failure it judges a false alarm rather than a bug, and report the remaining failures as bugs. Both tools were evaluated only on Python libraries, which take Python values as inputs and need no harness , the code that starts or feeds the program under test.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）可以阅读任何类型的软件制品，这将取代针对每种源代码的挖掘逻辑，并且它们可以编写新程序所需的生成器和判定器（oracle）。 我们将使用 LLM 来编写属性测试（PBT）的工具称为基于 LLM 的 PBT 编写器。 目前已提出两个通用型的工具。 Proptest-AI（Vikram 等人，2023）以一个 Python API 方法的文档作为提示来调用 LLM。 Agentic-PBT（Maaz 等人，2025）提示一个编码智能体（即可以运行命令和编辑文件的 LLM）去阅读 Python 模块的代码、编写属性测试、运行它们、修改那些其失败被它判定为误报而非缺陷的测试，并将其余的失败报告为缺陷。 这两个工具都只在 Python 库上进行了评估，这类库以 Python 值作为输入，不需要测试驱动（harness），即启动或向被测程序提供输入的代码。

paragraphs.en: Their evaluations therefore leave open whether an LLM can write PBTs for programs whose inputs are text in the program’s own language, such as queries, configuration files, or programs. Such an input is valid only under the program’s semantics, and a test usually reaches the program through a process or a server. For such programs, a developer must write a generator that builds valid inputs, and an oracle that either predicts the result or checks it against a second computation. A PBT writer that generalizes would bring property-based testing to database servers, compilers, and system software. Compilers and databases already have mature testing tools ( Yang et al., 2011 ; Le et al., 2014 ; Livinskii et al., 2020 ; Ou et al., 2024 ; Slutz, 1998 ; Rigger and Su, 2020c ; Rigger and Su, 2020a ; Rigger and Su, 2020b ; Zhong et al., 2020 ) , and such a writer would complement them with one tool that needs only a small harness per domain. We therefore ask: how well does an LLM-based PBT writer generalize across domains, and where does it fall short? To our knowledge, no study has evaluated such a writer on these programs or compared its tests across domains.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，它们的评估并未回答这样一个问题：对于输入为程序自身语言文本（如查询、配置文件或程序）的程序，LLM 能否为其编写 PBT。 这类输入只有在程序的语义下才有效，而且测试通常需要通过某个进程或服务器才能触达程序。 对于这类程序，开发者必须编写一个生成器来构造有效输入，并编写一个预言机来预测结果或将其与另一次计算的结果进行核对。 一个具备泛化能力的 PBT 编写器将把基于属性的测试带到数据库服务器、编译器和系统软件领域。 编译器和数据库已经拥有成熟的测试工具（ Yang et al., 2011 ; Le et al., 2014 ; Livinskii et al., 2020 ; Ou et al., 2024 ; Slutz, 1998 ; Rigger and Su, 2020c ; Rigger and Su, 2020a ; Rigger and Su, 2020b ; Zhong et al., 2020 ），这样的编写器将以每个领域只需一个小型测试工具的方式对它们形成补充。 因此我们提出问题：基于 LLM 的 PBT 编写器在不同领域之间的泛化能力如何，又在哪些方面有所不足？ 据我们所知，尚无研究在这类程序上评估过这样的编写器，也没有研究对其在不同领域生成的测试进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Our Work. We answer this question with a study of five domains: deep learning libraries, databases, system software, compilers, and LLM serving engines. We chose widely used domains that differ in how a test reaches the program and in the inputs it must build (Section 3 ). We study two programs per domain, ten programs in total: JAX ( Bradbury et al., 2018 ) and PyTorch ( Paszke et al., 2019 ) (deep learning libraries), PostgreSQL ( PostgreSQL Global Development Group, 2026a ) and ArangoDB ( ArangoDB GmbH, 2026 ) (databases), OpenSSH ( OpenBSD project, 2026 ) and cronie ( cronie developers, 2026a ) (system software), GCC ( GNU project, 2026 ) and Clang ( LLVM project, 2026 ) (compilers), and vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) and SGLang ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) (LLM serving engines). Databases, system software, and compilers are reached only through a process or a server, which no prior evaluation covered. For these domains, we give the tools a harness that only runs the program and returns its output, e.g., a module that starts a database server and returns the rows of a query. We write one harness per domain, in about 30 minutes with an LLM’s help, and the tests of its two programs share it. The harness does not check the output. The LLM writes all generators, properties, and oracles. Deep learning libraries serve as a control: a test calls them directly with Python values and needs no harness, as in the prior evaluations. LLM serving needs no harness either: tests call the engines’ Python APIs. Besides the harness, we change only the 32 of Agentic-PBT ’s 290 prompt lines that locate and read the target, and none of Proptest-AI ’s prompts. Each test targets a focal point , one feature of a program, such as an SQL function or a compiler builtin.

paragraphs.en: The study has four research questions. RQ1 assesses performance and selects the writer that RQ2 to RQ4 study. We compare the two LLM-based PBT writers with each other on all ten programs, with two LLMs from different vendors, Claude Opus 5 and GLM-5.3-Flash. We measure branch coverage and examine failure reports. RQ2 studies the selected writer, Agentic-PBT , per domain: the oracles of its tests and the sources of their properties. RQ3 counts the confirmed bugs that the tests reveal, those that maintainers accept as real. Because an LLM may have seen a bug report during training, a previously reported bug counts only if its first public report postdates the knowledge cutoff of the model that found it. paragraphs.en: Results. Agentic-PBT covers more branches than Proptest-AI on seven of the ten programs with Opus 5 and on all ten with GLM-5.3-Flash. Over 12 hours, the domain-specific tools cover more of the compilers and of PostgreSQL, where Agentic-PBT reaches 73% to 85% of the leading tool’s coverage, and Agentic-PBT covers 1.1 to 1.4 times as much of PyTorch as FlashFuzz and Centaur. On the compilers, MetaMut and GrayC find 23 and 4 crashes and Agentic-PBT 4, none in common. The documentation states the property of 78% of the tests, and 41% of their oracles compare the output with another run or another implementation rather than check a stated condition. paragraphs.en: Key Lessons. We highlight two of the lessons of Section 5.1 . First , low observability hurts PBT writers. A property can be documented and still be hard to check when the program does not show the behavior that the property concerns, which affects system-level tests most. A cronie test, for example, has to exceed one of cronie’s limits to reveal how cronie reads a crontab line. Second , mature fuzzers and LLM-based writers contribute different parts of a test. The fuzzers reach more of the compilers and of PostgreSQL, but they check crashes or, in SQLancer’s case, one relation between queries. The writers take most of their properties from the documentation, and most of the bugs Agentic-PBT found are wrong results that only such a property detects. Future work could have MetaMut or SQLancer check properties that an LLM extracts from the documentation.

paragraphs.en: We make three contributions: (1) a study of general-purpose LLM-based PBT writers on ten programs in five domains, most of which take text in their own language, which measures the coverage, failures, oracles, and bugs of their tests (Section 4 ); (2) lessons for building and evaluating such writers (Section 5.1 ); and (3) 65 new bugs confirmed by maintainers, and an artifact with the harnesses, prompts, scripts, tests, and bug reports of the study, so that others can repeat it with other models and writers (Data Availability).

paragraphs.en: Definition. Property-based testing checks that a program satisfies a property on many generated inputs ( Claessen and Hughes, 2000 ) . A program f : X → Y f:X\to Y usually accepts only part of its input space X X , the inputs that satisfy its precondition 𝑝𝑟𝑒 \mathit{pre} ; we call them valid . Given a property P P , a property-based test approximates ∀ x ∈ X : 𝑝𝑟𝑒 ⁡ ( x ) ⇒ P ⁡ ( x , f ⁡ ( x ) ) \forall x\in X:\mathit{pre}(x)\Rightarrow P(x,f(x)) by checking it on sampled inputs, because X X is usually too large to enumerate. A property-based test (PBT) has two parts. A generator samples inputs x x from X X ; it should draw only valid ones. An oracle evaluates P ⁡ ( x , f ⁡ ( x ) ) P(x,f(x)) on each sampled input x x and the program’s output f ⁡ ( x ) f(x) , usually as an assertion, and decides whether the execution is acceptable ( Barr et al., 2015 ) . The test fails when the oracle rejects an input, and that input is a counterexample to the property. A failure on an invalid input, or on a property the program never promised, is usually a false alarm , not a bug.

paragraphs.en: PBT libraries. PBT libraries provide building blocks for generators and a runner that executes a test on many inputs; the user combines these building blocks into a generator and writes the oracle. Examples are QuickCheck ( Claessen and Hughes, 2000 ) for Haskell and Hypothesis ( MacIver et al., 2019 ) for Python. In Hypothesis, a generator is called a strategy . The library provides strategies for common types, such as 𝚜𝚝 . 𝚒𝚗𝚝𝚎𝚐𝚎𝚛𝚜 ⁡ ( ) \mathtt{st.integers()} and 𝚜𝚝 . 𝚕𝚒𝚜𝚝𝚜 ⁡ ( ) \mathtt{st.lists()} , which can be combined into strategies for structured inputs. The @ ​ 𝚐𝚒𝚟𝚎𝚗 \mathtt{@given} decorator turns a test function with an assertion into a property-based test that runs the function on inputs drawn from the strategies. The @ ​ 𝚜𝚎𝚝𝚝𝚒𝚗𝚐𝚜 \mathtt{@settings} decorator configures the run; for example, @ ​ 𝚜𝚎𝚝𝚝𝚒𝚗𝚐𝚜 ​ ( 𝚖𝚊𝚡 ​ _ ​ 𝚎𝚡𝚊𝚖𝚙𝚕𝚎𝚜 = 𝙽 ) \mathtt{@settings(max\_examples=N)} sets how many inputs to draw, 100 by default. When the test fails, Hypothesis shrinks the failing input to a smaller one that still fails.

paragraphs.en: Proptest-AI . Proptest-AI ( Vikram et al., 2023 ) prompts an LLM with the documentation of one Python API method and asks for PBTs of that method. Its authors propose two prompting modes. The one-prompt mode uses one prompt, which asks for a list of properties and a test that checks them in the same answer. The two-prompt mode (Figure 2 ) splits this work into two prompts, sent in sequence in one conversation. The Stage 1 prompt gives the method’s name ( {function_name} ) and its documentation from the library’s website ( {api_documentation} ), and asks the LLM to list up to five properties of the method’s output. The Stage 2 prompt, sent after the LLM answers, asks for a Hypothesis test suite that checks the properties the LLM just listed. It ends with a template that imports the method’s module ( {module_name} ) and names the test function. The authors evaluate Proptest-AI on 40 deterministic API methods from ten Python libraries, such as 𝚗𝚞𝚖𝚙𝚢 \mathtt{numpy} , 𝚙𝚊𝚗𝚍𝚊𝚜 \mathtt{pandas} , 𝚗𝚎𝚝𝚠𝚘𝚛𝚔𝚡 \mathtt{networkx} , and 𝚍𝚊𝚝𝚎𝚝𝚒𝚖𝚎 \mathtt{datetime} , with GPT-4, Claude-3-Opus, and Gemini-1.5-Pro. In their best configuration, GPT-4 with two prompts, 41.74% of the tests from Stage 2 run without error and pass on the library, against 31.04% for the next best, Claude-3-Opus with two prompts.

paragraphs.en: Agentic-PBT . Agentic-PBT ( Maaz et al., 2025 ) is a natural-language prompt (Figure 2 ) that directs a coding agent , an LLM that runs commands and edits files, to write property-based tests for Python code, run them, and report bugs. The prompt takes one argument ( $ARGUMENTS ), the target: a Python module, file, or function, such as 𝚗𝚞𝚖𝚙𝚢 . 𝚕𝚒𝚗𝚊𝚕𝚐 \mathtt{numpy.linalg} . It lists six steps. The agent reads the target’s source code and documentation (steps 1–2). It proposes properties that the code claims in its docstrings, comments, or callers, and reads the callers to learn which inputs the target expects (step 3). It writes a Hypothesis test for each property (step 4). A strategy should draw only inputs the code expects; when it cannot also draw all of them, the prompt prefers missing valid inputs to drawing invalid ones. The agent then runs the tests with 𝚙𝚢𝚝𝚎𝚜𝚝 \mathtt{pytest} and triages each failure with a rubric in the prompt. The rubric asks whether the failure reproduces, whether callers can pass the failing input, and whether the code claims the property (step 5). When the agent judges a failure a false alarm, it revises the test, its strategy or its property, and reruns it. It reports each remaining failure with the failing test, the shrunk input, a reproducing script, and, when possible, a patch (step 6). The authors run Agentic-PBT with Claude Opus 4.1 on 933 modules of 100 Python packages, from the standard library to 𝚗𝚞𝚖𝚙𝚢 \mathtt{numpy} and 𝚙𝚊𝚗𝚍𝚊𝚜 \mathtt{pandas} . The agent reports 984 failures as likely bugs. The authors review 50 of these alarms, sampled from the 80% that an LLM ranks highest, and judge 28 to be real bugs.
paragraphs.zh: Agentic-PBT。 Agentic-PBT（Maaz et al., 2025）是一段自然语言提示词（图 2），它指示一个编码智能体——即一个可以运行命令并编辑文件的 LLM——为 Python 代码编写基于属性的测试、运行这些测试并报告缺陷。 该提示词接受一个参数（$ARGUMENTS），即目标：一个 Python 模块、文件或函数，例如 𝚗𝚞𝚖𝚙𝚢.𝚕𝚒𝚗𝚊𝚕𝚐。它列出了六个步骤。 该智能体阅读目标代码的源代码与文档（步骤 1–2）。 它提出代码在文档字符串、注释或调用方中声称的性质，并阅读调用方以了解目标代码期望哪些输入（步骤 3）。 它为每条性质编写一个 Hypothesis 测试（步骤 4）。 策略应当只生成代码所期望的输入；当策略无法同时生成全部这些输入时，提示词倾向于缺少有效输入而不是生成无效输入。 随后，该智能体使用 𝚙𝚢𝚝𝚎𝚜𝚝 运行这些测试，并按照提示词中的一套评分标准对每个失败进行甄别。 该评分标准会询问：失败是否可复现、调用方能否传入该失败输入、以及代码是否声称了该性质（步骤 5）。 当智能体判断某次失败为误报时，它会修改该测试、其策略或其性质，并重新运行。 对于每个剩余的失败，它会报告失败测试、收缩后的输入、一个可复现脚本，并在可能的情况下附带一个补丁（步骤 6）。 作者使用 Claude Opus 4.1 在 100 个 Python 包的 933 个模块上运行 Agentic-PBT，范围涵盖标准库到 𝚗𝚞𝚖𝚙𝚢 和 𝚙𝚊𝚗𝚍𝚊𝚜。 该智能体报告了 984 次失败，认为它们很可能是缺陷。 作者从 LLM 排名最高的那 80% 告警中抽样审查了其中的 50 个，并判定其中 28 个为真实缺陷。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 describes the tests of each domain by three characteristics, which the domain and its focal points fix. Level is where a test meets the program: an API-level test calls a function, and a system-level test runs a program or sends input to a running one. Input language is the form of the test’s input, from Python values to text in the program’s own language, such as SQL, C, or a configuration file. Harness is the code, beyond the generator and oracle, that builds, starts, or feeds the program under test. API-level tests call the program directly and have no harness.
paragraphs.zh: 表2通过三个特征描述各领域的测试，这些特征由该领域及其焦点决定。 层级是测试接触程序的位置：API级测试调用函数，系统级测试运行程序或向正在运行的程序发送输入。 输入语言是测试输入的形式，从Python值到程序自身语言的文本，例如SQL、C或配置文件。 测试载体是除生成器和判定器之外，用于构建、启动或向被测程序提供输入的代码。 API级测试直接调用程序，没有测试载体。

paragraphs.en: What separates our domains from the prior evaluations are the three characteristics of Table 2 . Deep learning libraries match the prior evaluations in all three. LLM serving also uses API calls without a harness, with inputs ranging from Python values to prompts and configurations. Databases, system software, and compilers differ in all three. In these three domains, the harness is one more function to call, since we write it and the writer reads its code, but the input is text in the program’s own language, valid only under the program’s semantics, and the oracle must know what that text means. The prior evaluations cover up to 933 Python modules ( Maaz et al., 2025 ) , all called with Python values; our ten programs are fewer, but a sharper test of whether a writer generalizes.
paragraphs.zh: 将我们的领域与先前评估区分开来的是表2中的三个特征。 深度学习库在这三个方面都与先前的评估一致。 LLM服务同样在没有测试框架的情况下使用API调用，输入范围从Python值到提示词和配置。 数据库、系统软件和编译器在这三个方面均有所不同。 在这三个领域中，测试框架只是多一个可供调用的函数，因为我们编写它，而编写者会阅读其代码，但输入是以程序自身语言写成的文本，仅在程序的语义下才有效，而判定标准必须知道这段文本的含义。 先前的评估最多涵盖933个Python模块（Maaz等，2025），全部以Python值调用；我们的十个程序数量更少，但对编写者是否具备泛化能力而言是更严格的检验。

sents.en: Deep learning libraries match the prior evaluations in all three.
sents.zh: 深度学习库在这三个方面都与先前的评估一致。

sents.en: LLM serving also uses API calls without a harness, with inputs ranging from Python values to prompts and configurations.
sents.zh: LLM服务同样在没有测试框架的情况下使用API调用，输入范围从Python值到提示词和配置。

sents.en: Databases, system software, and compilers differ in all three.
sents.zh: 数据库、系统软件和编译器在这三个方面均有所不同。

sents.en: In these three domains, the harness is one more function to call, since we write it and the writer reads its code, but the input is text in the program’s own language, valid only under the program’s semantics, and the oracle must know what that text means.
sents.zh: 在这三个领域中，测试框架只是多一个可供调用的函数，因为我们编写它，而编写者会阅读其代码，但输入是以程序自身语言写成的文本，仅在程序的语义下才有效，而判定标准必须知道这段文本的含义。

sents.en: The prior evaluations cover up to 933 Python modules ( Maaz et al., 2025 ) , all called with Python values; our ten programs are fewer, but a sharper test of whether a writer generalizes.
sents.zh: 先前的评估最多涵盖933个Python模块（Maaz等，2025），全部以Python值调用；我们的十个程序数量更少，但对编写者是否具备泛化能力而言是更严格的检验。

paragraphs.en: The tests of Section 3.2 rely on two further notions. A constraint on the inputs is relational when it relates one input to another. Because Hypothesis’s built-in strategies draw each value on its own, a relational constraint usually requires a custom generator : built-in strategies combined with 𝚏𝚒𝚕𝚝𝚎𝚛 \mathtt{filter} or 𝚖𝚊𝚙 \mathtt{map} , or a function written with @ ​ 𝚜𝚝 . 𝚌𝚘𝚖𝚙𝚘𝚜𝚒𝚝𝚎 \mathtt{@st.composite} . We name oracle families after the survey of Barr et al. ( Barr et al., 2015 ) , whose “assertions and contracts” and “pseudo-oracles” are our first two. A contract oracle checks one call against a condition on its outcome, including an expected output that the test computes from the input. A differential oracle compares the output with that of an independent implementation; it can be another program, another function or a different mode of the same program. A metamorphic oracle relates the outputs of two calls whose inputs differ in a known way. RQ2 (Section 4.2 ) adds two rarer families from the same survey.
paragraphs.zh: 第 3.2 节的测试依赖于另外两个概念。 当一个约束将一个输入与另一个输入关联起来时，该输入约束就是关系性的。 由于 Hypothesis 的内置策略是逐个独立生成每个值，关系性约束通常需要自定义生成器：即将内置策略与 𝚏𝚒𝚕𝚝𝚎𝚛 \mathtt{filter} 或 𝚖𝚊𝚙 \mathtt{map} 组合，或使用 @ ​ 𝚜𝚝.𝚌𝚘𝚖𝚙𝚘𝚜𝚒𝚝𝚎 \mathtt{@st.composite} 编写的函数。 我们依照 Barr 等人的综述来命名预言机家族。 （Barr 等人，2015），其中的“断言与契约”和“伪预言机”即我们的前两个家族。 契约预言机针对某次调用的结果检查一个条件，包括由测试根据输入计算出的期望输出。 差分预言机将输出与一个独立实现的输出进行比较；该实现可以是另一个程序、另一个函数，或同一程序的不同模式。 变换预言机将两次调用的输出关联起来，这两次调用的输入以已知方式不同。 RQ2（第 4.2 节）添加了来自同一综述的两个更少见的家族。

paragraphs.en: Deep Learning Libraries. JAX ( Bradbury et al., 2018 ) and PyTorch ( Paszke et al., 2019 ) are Python libraries for building and training neural networks, and many techniques test such libraries ( Zhang et al., 2022 ; Pham et al., 2019 ; Wei et al., 2022 ; Deng et al., 2022 ; Xie et al., 2022 ; Deng et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) . Their APIs take as inputs tensors , which are multi-dimensional arrays with a shape and an element type. A test calls an API directly. For example, Agentic-PBT ’s test of jax.lax.pmean , which averages a tensor over groups of devices, must draw groups that “cover all axis indices exactly once” ( The JAX Authors, 2026 ) , which a randomly drawn list of lists rarely does. Its custom generator draws one group label per device and groups the devices with the same label, and its oracle computes the mean of each group in NumPy and compares it with the output of the API.
paragraphs.zh: 深度学习库。 JAX（Bradbury 等，2018）和 PyTorch（Paszke 等，2019）是用于构建和训练神经网络的 Python 库，许多技术对这类库进行测试（Zhang 等，2022；Pham 等，2019；Wei 等，2022；Deng 等，2022；Xie 等，2022；Deng 等，2023；Liu 等，2023）。 它们的 API 以张量作为输入，张量是具有形状和元素类型的多维数组。 测试会直接调用 API。 例如，Agentic-PBT 对 jax.lax.pmean（该函数在一个张量上对若干设备组求平均）的测试，必须生成能“恰好覆盖所有轴索引一次”的分组（The JAX Authors, 2026），而随机生成的列表的列表很少能做到这一点。 其自定义生成器为每个设备抽取一个组标签，并将具有相同标签的设备分为一组，其预言机用 NumPy 计算每组设备的均值，并将其与 API 的输出进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Databases. A database server answers queries over its tables, and testing database servers has its own line of research ( Slutz, 1998 ; Rigger and Su, 2020c ; Rigger and Su, 2020a ; Rigger and Su, 2020b ; Zhong et al., 2020 ) . We study PostgreSQL ( PostgreSQL Global Development Group, 2026a ) , queried in SQL, and ArangoDB ( ArangoDB GmbH, 2026 ) , queried in AQL; a test writes a query as text, sends it to a running server, and checks the rows. Figure 3 shows a test of PostgreSQL’s nth_value(v, n) , which returns the value in the n n -th row of a window frame , a range of rows around each row. The test fills a query template with a table, a sort order, a frame clause, and a row index n n . Built-in strategies draw all but the frame clause, which needs a custom generator, 𝚌𝚞𝚜𝚝𝚘𝚖 ​ _ ​ 𝚐𝚎𝚗 \mathtt{custom\_gen} , because its two ends constrain each other. The generator orders the kinds of the two ends, as the manual requires when it states that “the frame_end choice cannot appear earlier […] than the frame_start choice does” ( PostgreSQL Global Development Group, 2026b ) . Sort keys draw from five values and NULL , so rows often tie, as in the example input (that reveals a failure); ties matter, in particular because the frame’s EXCLUDE options drop the current row or the rows tied with it. The test discards queries the server rejects, so it cannot detect a server that wrongly rejects a valid query. Its oracle is differential: it computes array_agg(v) , another function of the server, over the same frame in the same query and checks that nth_value equals its n n -th element, or NULL when the frame holds fewer than n n rows. The test fails for n = 1 n=1 and the frame ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE TIES : for the first of two tied rows that a third row follows, array_agg returns the third row’s value, but nth_value returns NULL ( PostgreSQL developers, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 数据库。 数据库服务器对其中的表回答查询，而测试数据库服务器本身已有一个研究方向（Slutz, 1998；Rigger and Su, 2020c；Rigger and Su, 2020a；Rigger and Su, 2020b；Zhong et al., 2020）。 我们研究以 SQL 查询的 PostgreSQL（PostgreSQL Global Development Group, 2026a）和以 AQL 查询的 ArangoDB（ArangoDB GmbH, 2026）；一个测试会把查询写成文本，发送给正在运行的服务器，并检查返回的行。 图 3 展示了对 PostgreSQL 的 nth_value(v, n) 的一个测试，该函数返回窗口帧（window frame）中第 n n 行的值，窗口帧是围绕每一行的一个行范围。 该测试用一个表、一个排序顺序、一个帧子句和一个行索引 n n 来填充查询模板。 内置策略会抽取除帧子句之外的所有部分，而帧子句需要一个自定义生成器 𝚌𝚞𝚜𝚝𝚘𝚖 ​ _ ​ 𝚐𝚎𝚗 \mathtt{custom\_gen}，因为它的两端会相互约束。 该生成器会对两端的种类进行排序，正如手册所要求的那样：“frame_end 选项不得出现在比 frame_start 选项更早的位置[…]”（PostgreSQL Global Development Group, 2026b）。 排序键从五个值和 NULL 中抽取，因此各行常常并列，就像示例输入那样（该输入揭示了一个失败）；并列很重要，尤其是因为帧的 EXCLUDE 选项会丢弃当前行或与它并列的行。 该测试会丢弃被服务器拒绝的查询，因此它无法检测出错误地拒绝有效查询的服务器。 它的预言机（oracle）是差分的：它在同一查询中针对同一帧计算服务器的另一个函数 array_agg(v)，并检查 nth_value 是否等于其第 n n 个元素，当帧中的行少于 n n 行时则为 NULL。 该测试在 n = 1 n=1 且帧为 ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE TIES 时会失败：对于后面跟着第三行的两行并列行中的第一行，array_agg 返回第三行的值，但 nth_value 返回 NULL（PostgreSQL developers, 2026）。

paragraphs.en: System Software. OpenSSH ( OpenBSD project, 2026 ) and cronie ( cronie developers, 2026a ) are Unix programs for remote login and job scheduling, and system software of this kind has been a target of fuzzing research ( Pham et al., 2020 ) . Each program reads a configuration file, such as sshd_config or a crontab, in a format that its manual page defines. A test writes a configuration file, runs a program on it, and parses what the program prints. Figure 4 shows a test of cronie’s program cronnext , which lists the times in a window at which a crontab’s job runs. The test fills a crontab line template with five generated time fields and draws the window with built-in strategies. A field can be an asterisk, a number, a range, a step, or a list of these, and crontab(5) states that in a range “the first number must be less than or equal to the second one” ( cronie developers, 2026c ) . The test therefore uses a custom generator, 𝚌𝚞𝚜𝚝𝚘𝚖 ​ _ ​ 𝚐𝚎𝚗 \mathtt{custom\_gen} , that draws each field within its bounds, keeps only a range whose ends are in order, and draws a step no larger than the field’s span; the figure ends with the draw on which the test fails. paragraphs.en: Compilers. Clang ( LLVM project, 2026 ) and GCC ( GNU project, 2026 ) compile C and C++ programs, and many techniques generate programs to test compilers ( Yang et al., 2011 ; Le et al., 2014 ; Livinskii et al., 2020 ; Chen et al., 2020 ) . A test compiles and runs a small program, which must be free of undefined behavior , because the C and C++ standards allow any output for such a program. Figure 5 shows a test of Clang’s __builtin_align_up and __builtin_align_down , which round a pointer to a multiple of an alignment and, the manual states, “are evaluatable inside constant expressions” ( The Clang Team, 2026 ) . The test fills a C++ program template, PROG , with five generated values: the alignment and size of an array whose byte i i holds i i modulo 256, an offset into it, the alignment to round to, and the direction. The program rounds the pointer at compile time and at run time and prints, for each, the result’s offset and the byte it points to. The manual states that if the alignment “is not a power of two at run time, the behavior of these builtins is undefined,” and that the result “must be within the same underlying allocation or one past the end” ( The Clang Team, 2026 ) . The custom generator, 𝚌𝚞𝚜𝚝𝚘𝚖 ​ _ ​ 𝚐𝚎𝚗 \mathtt{custom\_gen} , therefore draws both alignments as powers of two, which alignas also requires of the array’s, the size as a multiple of the array’s alignment, and an offset inside the array. The test discards a draw whose result leaves the array, even one past the end, because the program reads through the pointer. It also discards a program that fails to compile, so it cannot detect a compiler that wrongly rejects a valid program. Its oracle is differential: the test requires the compile-time results to equal the run-time ones. It also computes the rounded offset in Python and requires the run-time offset and byte to match it, which is a contract. The test fails when ba , al , and sz are 2, off is 1, and op is down : both offsets are 0 and the run-time read returns byte 0, but the compile-time read returns byte 1 ( LLVM developers, 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 编译器。 Clang（LLVM 项目，2026）和 GCC（GNU 项目，2026）用于编译 C 和 C++ 程序，许多技术会生成程序来测试编译器（Yang 等，2011；Le 等，2014；Livinskii 等，2020；Chen 等，2020）。 一个测试会编译并运行一个小程序，该程序必须没有未定义行为，因为 C 和 C++ 标准允许此类程序产生任意输出。 图 5 展示了对 Clang 的 __builtin_align_up 和 __builtin_align_down 的一个测试，这两个内建函数将指针对齐到某个对齐值的倍数，并且手册声明它们“可以在常量表达式中求值”（The Clang Team，2026）。 该测试用五个生成的值填充 C++ 程序模板 PROG：一个数组的对齐和大小（其第 i 个字节存放 i 模 256 的值）、指向该数组的一个偏移量、要对齐到的对齐值，以及方向。 该程序在编译时和运行时分别对指针进行对齐，并对每一种情况打印结果的偏移量及其所指向的字节。 手册声明，如果对齐值“在运行时不是 2 的幂，这些内建函数的行为是未定义的”，并且结果“必须位于同一底层分配之内或恰好越过其末尾一个位置”（The Clang Team，2026）。 因此，自定义生成器 𝚌𝚞𝚜𝚝𝚘𝚖 ​ _ ​ 𝚐𝚎𝚗 \mathtt{custom\_gen} 将两个对齐值都取为 2 的幂（这也是 alignas 对数组对齐的要求），将大小取为数组对齐值的倍数，并将偏移量取在数组内部。 该测试会舍弃使结果越出数组的抽取值，即使是恰好越过末尾一个位置也不行，因为程序要通过该指针进行读取。 它还会舍弃无法编译的程序，因此它无法检测出错误地拒绝有效程序的编译器。 其判定标准（oracle）是差分式的：测试要求编译时结果等于运行时结果。 它还会用 Python 计算对齐后的偏移量，并要求运行时的偏移量和字节与之匹配，这构成了一个契约。 当 ba、al 和 sz 为 2、off 为 1 且 op 为 down 时，该测试失败：两个偏移量都是 0，运行时读取返回字节 0，但编译时读取返回字节 1（LLVM developers，2026b）。

paragraphs.en: LLM Serving. An LLM serving engine answers prompts with a model: it batches requests, applies the fine-tuned weights that a request asks for, and streams each response as it is generated. Testing serving engines is a recent line of work ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . We study vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) and SGLang ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) , whose tests call Python APIs of the engines and their components or start a whole engine. For example, Agentic-PBT checks that a response does not depend on the other requests that the engine handles ( vLLM developers, 2026b ) , that streaming does not change it ( SGLang developers, 2026 ) , and that the engine applies the fine-tuned weights that it accepts ( vLLM developers, 2026a ) . Because a response has no single correct value, these properties compare two runs whose responses must be equal, as with different batches or streaming modes, or must differ, as with and without the fine-tuned weights.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 服务。 LLM 服务引擎使用模型来回答提示：它将请求分批处理，应用请求所需的微调权重，并在生成响应时逐一流式传输每个响应。 测试服务引擎是近期的一个研究方向（Liu 等，2026；Zhao 等，2026）。 我们研究了 vLLM（Kwon 等，2023）和 SGLang（Zheng 等，2024），它们的测试会调用引擎及其组件的 Python API，或者启动完整的引擎。 例如，Agentic-PBT 检查某个响应是否不依赖于引擎所处理的其他请求（vLLM 开发者，2026b），流式传输是否会改变该响应（SGLang 开发者，2026），以及引擎是否应用了它所接受的微调权重（vLLM 开发者，2026a）。 由于响应没有唯一正确的值，这些属性会比较两次运行：两次运行的响应必须相等，例如不同的批次或流式模式；或者必须不同，例如有和没有微调权重的情况。

paragraphs.en: RQ1 [ Performance ]: How do the two LLM-based PBT writers compare in coverage and failures?
paragraphs.zh: RQ1 [性能]：两种基于大语言模型（LLM）的 PBT 编写器在覆盖率和失败情况上有何差异？

paragraphs.en: Setup. Sampling focal points. For each target, we sample 30 of its documented focal points (Table 3 ) uniformly at random; on PyTorch, the 30 are the first 30 of the 50 APIs that RQ4 draws uniformly from the 368 that both of its fuzzers support. Both writers test the same focal points, which the artifact lists. Writers. We run both writers with two LLMs: Claude Opus 5, a proprietary frontier model, and GLM-5.3-Flash ( Z.ai, 2026 ) , an open-weights model from another vendor. We chose GLM-5.3-Flash because it comes from a vendor other than Anthropic, whose researchers developed Agentic-PBT , because its weights are open, so others can rerun the study without a proprietary API, and because it costs much less to run. The second model tests whether the comparison between the writers holds with another model. It does not test whether the writers perform equally well with both. Proptest-AI receives the documentation of each focal point. Following its original evaluation ( Vikram et al., 2023 ) , we use its two-prompt mode (Section 2.2 ) and repeat the procedure five times per focal point.

paragraphs.en: Harness. On the six targets outside Python, both writers use the harness of the target’s domain (Table 2 ); for Proptest-AI , we append a description of the harness to the documentation, without changing its prompts. We wrote each harness in about 30 minutes with the help of an LLM. The three harnesses total 511 lines of Python, 1.8% of the test code that Agentic-PBT writes for these targets. Execution environment. Each session , one run of the agent on one focal point, runs in its own container. The agent can read the target’s source code, build, and harness, and can write only to its working directory. RQ1 thus compares the writers as shipped: Agentic-PBT holds strictly more information than Proptest-AI , since it reads the code and the harness and runs its tests with execution feedback, whereas Proptest-AI sees only the documentation and the harness description, in five two-prompt runs. Budget. Each writer fuzzes its tests of a target for 30 minutes on 20 CPU cores, split evenly among its tests, so both writers spend the same fuzzing time on each target. We rerun each PBT with a new seed after it finishes or fails, until its allocated time ends. Each generation session is capped at 15 minutes. We do not cap the LLM cost, and we report it.

paragraphs.en: Number of Tests Generated and Cost. Table 4 gives, per target, the valid tests that each writer produces (property-based tests that pytest can run) and the LLM cost of producing them, with each LLM. For Proptest-AI , we sum the valid PBT functions across its five responses per focal point. With Opus 5, Agentic-PBT writes about a third as many tests as Proptest-AI , 2,352 against 6,853, at a similar cost, $670.6 against $645.5, or about $2.2 per focal point for each. With GLM-5.3-Flash, Agentic-PBT writes 1,633 tests for $12.9 and Proptest-AI 5,479 for $1.1. With Opus 5, Agentic-PBT also writes example-based tests for 41 of the 300 focal points, such as bug reproductions.

paragraphs.en: Coverage. We measure the branch coverage of each target as a whole, on coverage-instrumented builds (coverage.py for Python code, gcov or llvm-cov for C and C++). Figure 6 plots the coverage of each target over the fuzzing time, with the branches covered on the y-axis and the minutes on the x-axis. It has one column per domain, with the domain’s two targets one above the other. The color of a line gives the writer, and its style gives the LLM, solid for Claude Opus 5 and dashed for GLM-5.3-Flash. A dot ends each line and is labeled with its final coverage. With Opus 5, Agentic-PBT covers more branches than Proptest-AI on seven of the ten targets: by 33% to 136% on the four API-level targets, and by 2% to 8% on PostgreSQL, ArangoDB, and OpenSSH, where the margin on OpenSSH is barely above the variation between fuzzing runs reported below. Proptest-AI covers 5% to 9% more on GCC, Clang, and cronie. On GCC, switching to GLM-5.3-Flash reduces Proptest-AI ’s coverage from 296k to 169k branches, against 282k to 251k for Agentic-PBT . With GLM-5.3-Flash, both writers cover less, and Agentic-PBT covers more than Proptest-AI on all ten targets.

After setting the criteria, two authors independently classify 30 randomly sampled unique failures per writer as true or false positives. Their labels show substantial agreement ( κ \kappa = 0.69) ( Landis and Koch, 1977 ) . We resolve disagreements by discussing the evidence for each label. We judge a failure to be a true positive when it violates documented behavior, exposes a security defect, or disagrees with another implementation where both specify the same behavior. We exclude incorrect test expectations, including expectations about behavior left unspecified by the documentation. paragraphs.en: Setup. The population is the 2,622 property-based test functions of this configuration: the 2,352 tests of RQ1 (Table 4 ) and 270 tests on 20 further PyTorch focal points of RQ4 (Section 4.4 ). We sample 500 tests, 50 per target. We visit a target’s focal points in a seeded random order and take the first test of each, then the second test of each, and so on until we have 50, so no test is drawn twice. This draw underrepresents a focal point with many tests, so every share weights a sampled test by the number of tests of its focal point divided by the number we sampled from it ( Cochran, 1977 ) . A target’s weights thus sum to its number of tests, and a share over all tests weights each target by its tests. For the 95% confidence interval of a share, we use the normal interval with Kish’s effective sample size ( ∑ w ) 2 / ∑ w 2 (\sum w)^{2}/\sum w^{2} over the weights w w of the sampled tests ( Kish, 1965 ) , which treats the sampled tests as independent draws. The interval is at most ± \pm 12.4% within a domain and ± \pm 6.0% over all tests, so a difference between two domains is significant only when it exceeds 17 points.
paragraphs.zh: 实验设置。 总体是该配置下的 2,622 个基于性质的测试函数：即 RQ1 的 2,352 个测试（表 4）以及 RQ4 中针对另外 20 个 PyTorch 焦点的 270 个测试（第 4.4 节）。 我们抽样了 500 个测试，每个目标 50 个。 我们以固定种子的随机顺序访问某个目标的各个焦点，先取每个焦点的第一个测试，再取第二个测试，依此类推直到取满 50 个，因此不会有测试被重复抽取。 这种抽取方式低估了拥有较多测试的焦点，因此每个占比都按其焦点测试总数除以从该焦点中抽样的测试数来为抽样测试加权（Cochran, 1977）。 这样，一个目标的权重之和等于其测试总数，而所有测试的占比则按每个目标的测试数为该目标加权。 对于占比的 95% 置信区间，我们使用基于 Kish 有效样本量 (∑w)²/∑w²（即对抽样测试的权重 w 计算）的正态区间（Kish, 1965），该方法将抽样测试视为独立抽取。 该区间在单个领域内最大为 ±12.4%，在所有测试上最大为 ±6.0%，因此两个领域之间的差异只有在超过 17 个百分点时才显著。

paragraphs.en: Labels. The primary oracle of a test checks its intended property, as opposed to checks such as the type of an output the harness expects. Its family is contract, differential, or metamorphic, which Section 3.1 defines after Barr et al. ( Barr et al., 2015 ) . Two rarer families of the same survey also occur: algebraic (an operation followed by its inverse returns the original value) and implicit (the program does not crash). The primary source of a test’s property is the artifact that states it most directly: documentation (manuals and docstrings), code (the code under test and related code, such as a caller), the project’s tests, or another artifact, such as a standard or a reference implementation. When a test has several checks, its primary oracle is the one that the test’s name and docstring describe, or else its last assertion on the program’s output. The cronie test of Figure 4 , for example, has a contract as its primary oracle, because the expected times come from a model that the test itself computes, not from another implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 标签。 测试的主要判定器检查其预期属性，与之相对的是一些其他检查，例如测试工具所期望的输出类型。 其家族属于契约式、差分式或蜕变式，第 3.1 节将在 Barr 等人（Barr et al., 2015）之后给出这些定义。 同一综述中还出现了两个更罕见的家族：代数式（一个运算与其逆运算相继执行后返回原值）和隐式（程序不崩溃）。 测试属性的主要来源是最直接地陈述该属性的产物：文档（手册和文档字符串）、代码（被测代码及相关代码，例如调用者）、项目的测试，或其他产物，例如标准或参考实现。 当一个测试包含多个检查时，其主要判定器是该测试的名称和文档字符串所描述的那个检查，否则是其对程序输出的最后一条断言。 例如，图 4 的 cronie 测试以一个契约作为其主要判定器，因为期望的时间来自该测试自身计算出的模型，而非来自另一个实现。

paragraphs.en: Methods. An LLM agent (Claude Opus 5.5) labels the 500 tests. A second agent from another vendor (Gemini 3.1 Pro) labels an audit sample of 100, a seeded random draw of ten tests per target, without seeing the first agent’s labels. An author decides each disagreement. For the oracle, an agent picks one of ten kinds of check from a closed list. A script maps the kind to its family, so no labeler chooses a family directly; the artifact lists the ten kinds and their families. The two agents agree on the family for 82% of the audit sample ( κ \kappa = 0.72). For the source, a label names the artifact, the location, and the passage that states the property. paragraphs.en: Results. Figure 7 shows the families and the sources per domain. Contract oracles are the most common family in every domain, 54% of all tests, from 40% in the databases to 72% in LLM serving. Of all tests, 47.5% check an invariant of one output, 6.1% check that the program rejects an invalid input, and 0.8% check a documented value. The other 46% of the tests have a primary oracle of another family: metamorphic oracles relate two runs (21.3%), differential oracles compare with another implementation (19.3%), algebraic oracles check a round trip (3.5%), and implicit oracles check only that the program does not crash (1.5%). A test can also check more than its primary oracle, and Figure 7 counts only the primary one. The metamorphic and differential oracles together are the tests that compare a run with another run or implementation, 41% of all tests. They are fewest in LLM serving (22%) and most in the deep learning libraries (51%) and the databases (51%). What they compare with depends on the domain. In the deep learning libraries, tests compare with a reference library such as NumPy (27% differential). In system software, they check equivalences that the manual states (24% metamorphic), such as between a crontab line starting with @weekly and one starting with 0 0 * * 0 .

paragraphs.en: Setup. Sessions. We run Agentic-PBT with Opus 5, the configuration that RQ1 selects. The target versions are mostly older than RQ1 and RQ2, because we began the bug hunting campaigns earlier; Table 6 also counts the 30 bugs that RQ1’s sessions revealed on the versions of Table 3 . We run one session per focal point, and we choose the focal points from the target’s documentation, its test files, and the pull requests that fixed bugs. The agent receives only the focal point’s name, such as jax.numpy.histogram . Outside Python it also receives the harness of RQ1 (Section 4.1 ). Bug hunting uses a longer session cap than RQ1, so that a session can explore its focal point further: 20 minutes. LLM serving engines are capped at 1 hour to give the engine time to start. The agent reads a shallow checkout of the pinned commit, with no Git history, in a container whose only network access is the model’s API. These controls block online bug reports and the target’s history. The one attempt to fetch a web page was denied.
paragraphs.zh: 环境搭建。会话设置。 我们使用 Opus 5 运行 Agentic-PBT，即 RQ1 所选定的配置。 目标版本的发布时间大多早于 RQ1 和 RQ2 的目标版本，因为我们更早开始了漏洞挖掘活动；表 6 还统计了 RQ1 的会话在表 3 的版本上发现的 30 个漏洞。 我们为每个焦点运行一个会话，焦点选自目标项目的文档、测试文件以及修复漏洞的拉取请求。 智能体仅获得焦点的名称，例如 jax.numpy.histogram。 在 Python 之外，它还会获得 RQ1 的测试框架（第 4.1 节）。 漏洞挖掘使用了比 RQ1 更长的会话时长上限，以便会话能够更深入地探索其焦点：20 分钟。 LLM 服务引擎的时长上限为 1 小时，以给引擎留出启动时间。 智能体在一个容器中读取固定提交的浅层检出代码，不包含 Git 历史，该容器的唯一网络访问权限是模型的 API。 这些控制措施阻断了在线漏洞报告以及目标项目的历史记录。 唯一一次获取网页的尝试被拒绝了。

paragraphs.en: Fuzzing and triage. After generation, we fuzz every test without an LLM for one hour per focal point on one CPU core. A failure is a test that violates its oracle or crashes. We deduplicate crashes by their top two stack frames and other failures by test and exception type. An LLM agent discards false positives and merges the rest into distinct candidate bugs . We read a candidate ourselves, reproduce it on the newest release of the target (on the compilers, the development head), and report it with a standalone reproducer. A reported candidate is a bug , which developers confirm, reject, or leave pending. A confirmed bug is a duplicate if someone outside this project reported it before a session found it, and new otherwise; new bugs are fixed or await a fix. As in Section 1 , a previously reported bug counts only if its first public report postdates the training cutoff of the model that found it. When Opus 5 finds a bug that was first reported before its cutoff (May 2026), we rerun the focal point in an isolated session with Opus 4.8, whose cutoff is January 2026. We count the bug only if Opus 4.8 finds it again and the report postdates January 2026, and otherwise we set the bug aside.
paragraphs.zh: 模糊测试与分诊。 生成之后，我们在单个 CPU 核心上，对每个焦点在不使用大语言模型的情况下对每个测试进行一小时模糊测试。 失败是指违反其预言机或发生崩溃的测试。 我们按崩溃的最上面两层栈帧对崩溃去重，并按测试和异常类型对其余失败去重。 一个大语言模型智能体会剔除误报，并将其余的合并为不同的候选缺陷。 我们亲自阅读候选缺陷，在目标的最新版本上（在所用编译器和开发主干上）复现它，并用一个独立可复现的程序提交报告。 已提交报告的候选缺陷即是一个缺陷，由开发者确认、拒绝或搁置。 已确认的缺陷，如果在本项目的会话发现它之前已有本项目之外的人报告过，则为重复缺陷，否则为新缺陷；新缺陷会被修复或等待修复。 如第 1 节所述，此前已报告过的缺陷只有在其首次公开报告的时间晚于发现它的模型的训练截止日期时才计入。 当 Opus 5 发现一个在其截止日期（2026 年 5 月）之前首次报告的缺陷时，我们会在隔离会话中用 Opus 4.8（其截止日期为 2026 年 1 月）重新运行该焦点。 只有当 Opus 4.8 再次发现该缺陷且报告时间晚于 2026 年 1 月时，我们才计入该缺陷，否则将其搁置。

paragraphs.en: Bugs. Table 6 shows the bugs we reported per domain and target, by status: confirmed, rejected, or pending. It splits the confirmed ones into those awaiting a fix, those fixed, and the duplicates. We have reported 180 bugs on 10 targets: 109 are confirmed, 68 pending, and 3 rejected. Of the confirmed bugs, 44 are duplicates, which leaves 136 reports not known to duplicate an earlier one; of these, maintainers confirmed 65 new bugs, of which 23 are fixed. Only 24 of the 180 reported bugs are crashes, uncaught exceptions, or hangs. The other 156 are wrong results, which a test detects only through its oracle. Our experiments cover 742 focal points in total: 180 in the deep learning libraries, 153 in LLM serving, 240 in the databases, 77 in system software, and 92 in the compilers. We read and reported 0.24 (180/742) bugs per focal point, and the developers have confirmed 0.09 (65/742) new bugs per focal point, or 0.15 (109/742) counting the duplicates. In LLM serving, 36 of the 44 confirmed bugs are duplicates, which leaves 0.05 (8/153) new bugs per focal point, the second-lowest rate after the databases’ 0.02 (5/240); system software has the highest, 0.18 (14/77). The developers rejected 2% (3/180) of the reports: 7% (1/14) in the compilers, 2% (1/50) in the deep learning libraries, 2% (1/66) in LLM serving, and none in the databases and system software. In the databases, 26 of 32 reports are still pending (8 of PostgreSQL’s 9), so their 0.02 new confirmed bugs per focal point is a lower bound, which rises to 0.13 if maintainers confirm every pending report as new.

paragraphs.en: Examples. Figure 8 shows two of these bugs as minimal reproducers. Figure 8(a) shows a bug in ArangoDB’s AQL function SUBSTITUTE(value, search, replace) , which, as its manual states, replaces “all occurrences of search ” in value with replace . The test draws the three strings from lowercase letters, runs the query through the harness, and requires the result to equal that of Python’s str.replace , without an exception and without a warning. It fails when value is empty: SUBSTITUTE returns null with a warning instead of the empty string. The developers confirmed the bug, merged a fix the next day, and released it in ArangoDB 3.12.12 ( ArangoDB developers, 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: Figure 8(b) shows a bug in Clang’s vectorcall attribute, which, as Clang’s manual states, “changes the calling convention of a function,” i.e., the way a call passes the function’s arguments. paragraphs.en: RQ4 asks how much Agentic-PBT ’s tests and the fuzzers built for three of our domains cover, and which crashes each finds that the other does not. The fuzzers’ oracles differ from a property-based test’s, so other failures are not comparable: MetaMut and GrayC detect compiler crashes, Centaur and FlashFuzz PyTorch crashes, and SQLancer crashes and one fixed relation between queries.

paragraphs.en: Setup. Tools and targets. We compare with MetaMut ( Ou et al., 2024 ) and GrayC ( Even-Mendoza et al., 2023 ) on GCC and Clang, with SQLancer ( Rigger and Su, 2020b ) on PostgreSQL, and with Centaur ( Naziri et al., 2026 ) and FlashFuzz ( Qin et al., 2026 ) on PyTorch. We omit JAX, which the evaluated versions of Centaur and FlashFuzz do not support, and ArangoDB, whose support SQLancer has removed ( SQLancer developers, 2024 ) . Each tool runs in its default configuration, and the artifact lists the versions. MetaMut and GrayC start from the seed corpora of their releases. Budget. Agentic-PBT uses Opus 5 and RQ1’s generation setup. Each tool then runs once for 12 hours on 20 CPU cores on the instrumented builds of RQ1; the 12 hours cover fuzzing only, and Agentic-PBT ’s test generation (Table 4 ) precedes them. Agentic-PBT ’s tests share the budget equally and run one after another on each core, so its early coverage is lower than in RQ1 (Figure 6 ). Coverage. On PyTorch, all three tools test the same 50 APIs, sampled from those that both fuzzers support, and we measure each tool’s branch coverage only during calls to these APIs, as Centaur’s evaluation does ( Naziri et al., 2026 ) . On the other targets, we measure the coverage of the whole program. Crashes. We replay the inputs that Agentic-PBT , MetaMut, and GrayC saved on the evaluated compiler builds, replay FlashFuzz’s inputs on PyTorch, and check the child process’s signal for Agentic-PBT ’s PyTorch crash. We count the crashes that reproduce, whether or not they were reported before, and deduplicate them per compiler and tool by the first two function names in the stack trace.

paragraphs.en: We draw three lessons from our results: two for building and evaluating PBT writers, and one on how such writers relate to the fuzzers that already test these domains.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从结果中得出三点启示：两点关于构建和评估 PBT 编写器，一点关于此类编写器与已经测试这些领域的模糊测试工具之间的关系。

paragraphs.en: (1) Low observability hurts PBT writers. Observability is how much of a program’s behavior its outputs reveal ( Freedman, 1991 ) . A property can be documented and still be hard to check, because the program does not show the behavior that the property concerns. This affects system-level tests most, which see only what the program prints. crontab(5) states which lines of a crontab are environment settings and which are jobs, but cronie’s output does not say how it read a given line. An Agentic-PBT test works around this with cronie’s limit of 1,000 environment settings: it writes 1,000 settings and then the line under test, so cronie reports an error if it reads that line as a setting and accepts the file if it reads it as a job. The test thus depends on knowledge beyond the property, which the LLM supplied. A writer facing low observability needs either the knowledge, from the LLM or from the user through a prompt that asks for it, or a way to raise observability, for example probes that expose the program’s internal decisions, neither of which we tried.
paragraphs.zh: （1）低可观测性给 PBT 使用者带来困扰。 可观测性指一个程序的输出能在多大程度上揭示其行为（Freedman, 1991）。 一个性质即使被写成了文档，也可能仍然难以检验，因为程序没有展示该性质所涉及的行为。 这对系统级测试影响最大，因为它们只能看到程序打印的内容。crontab(5) 规定了 crontab 中哪些行是环境设置、哪些行是任务，但 cronie 的输出并没有说明它是如何读取某一行内容的。 一个 Agentic-PBT 测试利用 cronie 的 1,000 条环境设置上限绕开了这一问题：该测试先写入 1,000 条设置，再写入被测的行，因此如果 cronie 将该行当作设置来读取，它就会报告错误，而如果当作任务来读取，它就会接受该文件。 因此，该测试依赖于性质之外的知识，这些知识由 LLM 提供。 面对低可观测性的使用者，要么需要这类知识——可以来自 LLM，也可以来自用户通过一个明确要求提供这些知识的提示（prompt）——要么需要一种提高可观测性的手段，例如暴露程序内部决策的探针；这两者我们都未曾尝试。

paragraphs.en: (2) Evaluate a writer’s reports as well as its final tests. While it writes its tests, a writer can find a failure and then stop generating the inputs that reveal it. On torch.fft.ifftshift , the session reported a failure for calls with no dimensions to rearrange, but its final test no longer generates such calls. Agentic-PBT at least keeps such failures in its reports. Evaluations should therefore include a writer’s reports, and writers should record the inputs they exclude.
paragraphs.zh: (2) 评估编写者的报告以及其最终测试。 在编写测试时，编写者可能会发现一个失败，然后停止生成能揭示该失败的输入。 在 torch.fft.ifftshift 上，会话报告了对没有需要重排的维度的调用的失败，但其最终测试不再生成此类调用。 Agentic-PBT 至少能将这类失败保留在其报告中。 因此，评估应包括编写者的报告，且编写者应记录其排除的输入。

paragraphs.en: Internal validity. Each writer generates its tests once per configuration; the repeated fuzzing measures the variability of those tests, not of their generation. RQ4 runs each tool only once. We wrote the harnesses, which could favor one writer, but both use the same harness, which only runs the program and returns its output. Humans judge RQ1’s sampled failures, but an LLM agent triages RQ3’s failures and LLM agents label RQ2’s tests; a second vendor’s agent relabels an audit sample and an author decides each disagreement, and the labels with low agreement remain a threat. The triage agent of RQ3 and the primary labeler of RQ2 are Claude models, from the vendor of the writer’s main LLM; the Gemini audit mitigates this for RQ2, and for RQ3 we read every candidate we report, although we do not review the failures the triage discards. A bug may be in a model’s training data, so we exclude bugs reported before the model’s cutoff and recheck earlier ones with a model whose cutoff is earlier. Construct validity. Branch coverage of a whole target includes code that every test reaches, such as start-up code, and coverage does not measure fault finding. Unique failures depend on how we deduplicate them, by error message or stack trace, which can merge distinct bugs or split one. Confirmed bugs depend on maintainers, and pending reports make our rates lower bounds. External validity. We study two programs in each of five domains, two writers, and two LLMs, so our results may not hold for other programs, domains, writers, or models. We sample 30 focal points per target, and on PyTorch RQ4 samples only the APIs that Centaur and FlashFuzz support. All tests use Hypothesis, on selected versions of each target.

sents.en: Each writer generates its tests once per configuration; the repeated fuzzing measures the variability of those tests, not of their generation.
sents.zh: 每个写入器在每个配置下只生成一次测试；重复的模糊测试衡量的是这些测试的可变性，而不是其生成过程的可变性。

sents.en: RQ4 runs each tool only once.
sents.zh: RQ4 对每个工具只运行一次。

sents.en: We wrote the harnesses, which could favor one writer, but both use the same harness, which only runs the program and returns its output.
sents.zh: 测试驱动程序是我们编写的，这可能偏向某个写入器，但两者使用相同的驱动程序，它只负责运行程序并返回其输出。

sents.en: Humans judge RQ1’s sampled failures, but an LLM agent triages RQ3’s failures and LLM agents label RQ2’s tests; a second vendor’s agent relabels an audit sample and an author decides each disagreement, and the labels with low agreement remain a threat.
sents.zh: RQ1 的抽样失败由人工判断，但 RQ3 的失败由一个 LLM 智能体分类，RQ2 的测试由 LLM 智能体标注；另一厂商的智能体对审计样本重新标注，由一位作者对每个分歧做出裁决，而一致性较低的标签仍构成威胁。

sents.en: The triage agent of RQ3 and the primary labeler of RQ2 are Claude models, from the vendor of the writer’s main LLM; the Gemini audit mitigates this for RQ2, and for RQ3 we read every candidate we report, although we do not review the failures the triage discards.
sents.zh: RQ3 的分类智能体和 RQ2 的主要标注者是 Claude 模型，来自写入器主要 LLM 的厂商；Gemini 审计缓解了 RQ2 的这一问题，而对于 RQ3，我们阅读了我们报告的每个候选对象，尽管我们并未审查被分类智能体丢弃的失败。

sents.en: A bug may be in a model’s training data, so we exclude bugs reported before the model’s cutoff and recheck earlier ones with a model whose cutoff is earlier. Construct validity.
sents.zh: 某个缺陷可能存在于模型的训练数据中，因此我们排除了在模型截止日期之前报告的缺陷，并用一个截止日期更早的模型复查更早的缺陷。构建效度。

sents.en: Branch coverage of a whole target includes code that every test reaches, such as start-up code, and coverage does not measure fault finding.
sents.zh: 整个目标的分支覆盖包括每个测试都会到达的代码，例如启动代码，而且覆盖率并不能衡量缺陷发现能力。

sents.en: Unique failures depend on how we deduplicate them, by error message or stack trace, which can merge distinct bugs or split one.
sents.zh: 唯一失败的判定取决于我们如何去重，即按错误消息还是堆栈跟踪，这可能合并不同的缺陷或拆分同一个缺陷。

sents.en: Confirmed bugs depend on maintainers, and pending reports make our rates lower bounds. External validity.
sents.zh: 缺陷的确认取决于维护者，尚未处理的报告使我们的比率成为下界。外部效度。

sents.en: We study two programs in each of five domains, two writers, and two LLMs, so our results may not hold for other programs, domains, writers, or models.
sents.zh: 我们在五个领域中各研究两个程序、两个写入器和两个 LLM，因此我们的结果可能不适用于其他程序、领域、写入器或模型。

sents.en: We sample 30 focal points per target, and on PyTorch RQ4 samples only the APIs that Centaur and FlashFuzz support.
sents.zh: 我们对每个目标抽取 30 个焦点，并且在 PyTorch 上 RQ4 只抽样 Centaur 和 FlashFuzz 支持的 API。

sents.en: All tests use Hypothesis, on selected versions of each target.
sents.zh: 所有测试都使用 Hypothesis，针对每个目标的选定版本。

paragraphs.en: Mining properties and oracles. Before LLMs, each tool mined one kind of property from one source. Daikon ( Ernst et al., 2001 ) infers likely invariants from execution traces; Toradocu ( Goffi et al., 2016 ) , MeMo ( Blasi et al., 2021 ) , and CallMeMaybe ( Blasi et al., 2022 ) extract exception, metamorphic, and temporal oracles from Javadoc comments; MR-Scout ( Xu et al., 2024 ) mines metamorphic relations from existing tests; and DeepREL ( Deng et al., 2022 ) infers relations between the APIs of deep learning libraries. TOGA ( Dinella et al., 2022 ) and ChatAssert ( Hayet et al., 2025 ) generate assertions for a given test with a neural model or an LLM, and Endres et al. ( Endres et al., 2024 ) have an LLM turn natural-language intent into postconditions. An LLM-based PBT writer instead produces the generator, the property, and the oracle together, from whatever artifact states the property.
paragraphs.zh: 挖掘性质与预言（oracle）。 在大语言模型出现之前，每个工具只能从单一来源挖掘一种性质。 Daikon（Ernst 等，2001）从执行轨迹中推断可能的不变量；Toradocu（Goffi 等，2016）、MeMo（Blasi 等，2021）和 CallMeMaybe（Blasi 等，2022）从 Javadoc 注释中提取异常、蜕变与时序预言；MR-Scout（Xu 等，2024）从既有测试中挖掘蜕变关系；DeepREL（Deng 等，2022）推断深度学习库的 API 之间的关系。 TOGA（Dinella 等，2022）和 ChatAssert（Hayet 等，2025）利用神经网络模型或大语言模型为给定测试生成断言，而 Endres 等人 （Endres 等，2024）让大语言模型把自然语言意图转化为后置条件。 基于大语言模型的 PBT 编写器则相反，它从任何陈述性质的制品中一并产出生成器、性质和预言。

paragraphs.en: Test generation and fuzzing. Property-based testing has been joined with coverage-guided fuzzing before LLMs: JQF and Zest ( Padhye et al., 2019a ; Padhye et al., 2019b ) , FuzzChick ( Lampropoulos et al., 2019 ) , and RLCheck ( Reddy et al., 2020 ) steer a generator toward valid and diverse inputs with coverage feedback or reinforcement learning, but the property and the generator come from the user. LLMs also write unit tests ( Schäfer et al., 2024 ; Lemieux et al., 2023 ) and fuzz inputs, either for one domain, as TitanFuzz ( Deng et al., 2023 ) does for deep learning libraries, or for many languages at once, as Fuzz4All ( Xia et al., 2024 ) does; WhiteFox ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , KernelGPT ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and ChatAFL ( Meng et al., 2024 ) have an LLM read a compiler’s, a kernel’s, or a protocol’s source or specification to steer a fuzzer’s inputs. Unit tests check one input each, fuzzers detect mostly crashes, and LLM-based test generators can discard the tests that reveal bugs ( Mathews and Nagappan, 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 测试生成与模糊测试。 在大语言模型出现之前，基于性质的测试已与覆盖率引导的模糊测试相结合：JQF 和 Zest（Padhye et al., 2019a；Padhye et al., 2019b）、FuzzChick（Lampropoulos et al., 2019）以及 RLCheck（Reddy et al., 2020）利用覆盖率反馈或强化学习引导生成器产生有效且多样的输入，但性质和生成器都由用户提供。 大语言模型还能编写单元测试（Schäfer et al., 2024；Lemieux et al., 2023）并对输入进行模糊测试，有的针对单一领域，如 TitanFuzz（Deng et al., 2023）针对深度学习库，有的同时面向多种语言，如 Fuzz4All（Xia et al., 2024）；WhiteFox（Yang et al., 2024）、KernelGPT（Yang et al., 2025）和 ChatAFL（Meng et al., 2024）让大语言模型阅读编译器、内核或协议的源代码或规范，以引导模糊测试器的输入。 单元测试每次只检查一个输入，模糊测试器主要检测崩溃，而基于大语言模型的测试生成器可以丢弃那些暴露缺陷的测试（Mathews and Nagappan, 2024）。

paragraphs.en: Domain-specific testing. The system-level domains of our study have mature testing tools: Csmith ( Yang et al., 2011 ) , EMI ( Le et al., 2014 ) , YARPGen ( Livinskii et al., 2020 ) , MetaMut ( Ou et al., 2024 ) , and GrayC ( Even-Mendoza et al., 2023 ) for compilers, and RAGS ( Slutz, 1998 ) , PQS ( Rigger and Su, 2020c ) , NoREC ( Rigger and Su, 2020a ) , TLP ( Rigger and Su, 2020b ) , and Squirrel ( Zhong et al., 2020 ) for databases; deep learning libraries have Centaur ( Naziri et al., 2026 ) and FlashFuzz ( Qin et al., 2026 ) , and testing LLM serving engines is just beginning ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . RQ4 compares Agentic-PBT with five of them.

paragraphs.en: We asked how far LLM-based PBT writers, built and evaluated on Python libraries, carry over to compilers, databases, system software, and LLM serving engines. They carry over, with two limits. Agentic-PBT wrote property-based tests in all five domains, took most of their properties from the documentation, and revealed 65 new bugs that maintainers confirmed in all ten programs; most of the bugs we reported are wrong results that only an oracle detects. It covered more than Proptest-AI on seven of the ten programs with Opus 5 and on all ten with GLM-5.3-Flash. The first limit is coverage: the generators reach 73 to 85% of a mature fuzzer’s coverage on the compilers and PostgreSQL, where MetaMut finds 23 compiler crashes against Agentic-PBT ’s 4, none in common; on PyTorch, Agentic-PBT covers more than its fuzzers. The second is observability: some documented properties are hard to check because the program’s output does not reveal the behavior they concern. The coverage gap suggests a remedy. The fuzzers check for crashes or, in SQLancer’s case, for one fixed relation between queries, while the writer supplies the documented property; a fuzzer’s generator steered toward a property’s focal point could reach the inputs that the writer’s generator does not.
paragraphs.zh: 我们探究了在 Python 库上构建和评估的基于 LLM 的 PBT 编写器，能在多大程度上迁移到编译器、数据库、系统软件和 LLM 服务引擎。 它们可以迁移，但有两个局限。 Agentic-PBT 在全部五个领域编写了基于属性的测试，其大部分属性取自文档，并发现了 65 个新缺陷，这些缺陷已被维护者在全部十个程序中确认；我们报告的缺陷大多是只有预言器才能发现的错误结果。 使用 Opus 5 时，它在十个程序中的七个上覆盖了比 Proptest-AI 更多的内容；使用 GLM-5.3-Flash 时，它在全部十个程序上都是如此。 第一个局限是覆盖率：在编译器和 PostgreSQL 上，这些生成器达到成熟模糊测试工具覆盖率的 73% 至 85%，其中 MetaMut 发现了 23 个编译器崩溃，而 Agentic-PBT 只有 4 个，且没有共同之处；在 PyTorch 上，Agentic-PBT 的覆盖率超过其模糊测试工具。 第二个局限是可观测性：某些文档化的属性难以检查，因为程序的输出并未揭示它们所关注的行为。 覆盖率差距提示了一种补救办法。 模糊测试工具检查崩溃，或者在 SQLancer 的情形中检查查询之间的某个固定关系，而编写器提供文档化的属性；将模糊测试工具的生成器引导至某个属性的焦点，或许能到达编写器的生成器无法到达的输入。
